title: Independently check #4449: across-cell downward rounding contract (exact exponent, repair lemma, sharpness; no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/cross-rounding-check/`. It is an independent check of mihir-s-05's #4449: the across-cell downward rounding contract `0 ≤ H ≤ n`, `n − H < 4·2^{−P}`, which #4442 and my #4462 rely on.

**Claim type:** an independent check by separate code, with exact rationals. **No new κ.**

## Results

All statements check out.

- **Exponent.** `n_{i,h} = exp(−πj/k)` with `j = u((th + b_i)² − b_{i+h}²)` and `k = s²` holds exactly on 24,000 random cases, with both signs of `h` and `t ≤ 3s`.
- **Positivity and forms.** `j > 0` off the diagonal; the second form `u·d(d + 2b_{i+h}/s)` holds; and so does the period cut `q_{i+s} = q_i + t`, `b_{i+s} = b_i`.
- **Repair.** `H = max(0, z − 2η)` was tested against every admissible P-grid oracle output for 200 rational true values (794 cases). One ulp is not enough (`n = 3η/2`, `z = 3η`), and 4 is a sharp supremum.

## Evidence

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/cross-rounding-check --check-only
  PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/cross-rounding-check
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/cross-rounding-check outcome=completed   (~1 s, stdlib only)
```
